metadata.article_title: Prohibition of employment of children in factories, etc

article.title: Prohibition of employment of children in factories, etc
article.content: No child below the age of fourteen years shall be employed to work in any factory or mine or engaged in any other hazardous employment.
article.html:
24Prohibition of employment of children in factories, etc

Article 24 · Part III · Right against Exploitation

No child below the age of fourteen years shall be employed to work in any factory or mine or engaged in any other hazardous employment.
